mathematical_definition: tick_volume minus that hour-of-day's expanding (since dataset inception), causally shifted-by-1, per-hour-bucket mean (pandas groupby(hour).expanding(min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)) -- how anomalous current tick activity is relative to its own hour-of-day's historical norm
numerical_stability_notes: Implementation is pandas groupby(hour_of_day).expanding(min_periods=20).mean().shift(1) -- an expanding mean PER HOUR-OF-DAY computed SINCE THE START OF THE ENTIRE DATASET, not a trailing/rolling window. A bounded live buffer (a few hundred M1 bars, roughly 8 hours) cannot reproduce this since-inception per-hour running average -- it would need the full historical hour-grouped state. Not something the live buffer can approximate; therefore marked live_compatible=false / historical_coverage=RESEARCH_ONLY rather than silently computed wrong. Phase 4 or later could build a proper incremental per-hour accumulator.
missing_value_policy: NaN until that bar's hour-of-day bucket has accumulated >=20 prior observations since dataset inception (expanding min_periods=20, shifted by 1 for causality); never zero-filled
